caption: The drawing shows a detailed depiction of a four-wheeled cart or carriage with large, thin, spoke wheels in a pale, wood-like color. The cart frame is constructed from similar pale materials, with metal elements visible in the structure. At the rear, there are two ornate, gold-colored posts topped with decorations, and near them are red cylindrical objects that could be lanterns. In the center of the cart is a drum or reel with a crank and metal fittings, and to the left side is an arched frame supporting a bell with dark metal coloring. The entire cart is illustrated against a blank, beige or parchment-colored background, and all objects are rendered with realistic shading, emphasizing the form and structure of the components without any visible human or animal figures.
title: Fire Hose Reel
